parameter_semantics: object_pose_field names the manipulated block world pose used as a fresh SE(3) action reference; destination_pose_field names the observed world destination pose used for conditioning; tunnel_clearance_m is the 0.16 m world-z roof clearance used in the signed input margin. Demonstration bindings use object_pose, target_pose and 0.16.
output_semantics: Each slot is [object-frame TCP x,y,z metres, object-frame TCP rotation 6D as first two columns, gripper scalar]. The reference is the observed block pose immediately before that slot; decode composes with the freshly observed block pose to form a world TCP target, Gram-Schmidt projects 6D rotation with a deterministic finite fallback, then calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1..8.

conversion_check.description: Encode/decode must recover the demonstrated command FK TCP pose and gripper scalar within 0.01 maximum metres/radians/scalar; IK is initialized from the measured joints and its residuals are reported.

cut_relation: Uses every assigned [300,840) action for all 12 demonstrations, preserving predecessor overlap [300,440) and successor overlap [680,840); only the Cartesian representation and causal conditioning are changed.
